newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down one cent despite London's gain.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down one cent despite London's gain.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down one cent at 14.35 ringgit ($5.76) a kg, despite a $40 rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.
They said a high local price premium over the LME and higher offerings at the outset weighed on the price.
There were initial offers for 112 tonnes against bids for 95 tonnes. Final turnover was 95 tonnes, down from 124 on Tuesday, and buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
The premium over the LME narrowed to $125 a tonne against $150 previously, traders said.
